title: CrapReport
description: Structured `--json` output envelope emitted by check-crap.js. Mirrors the shape consumed by agent workflows — a kernel/escomplex version pair, aggregate counters, and per-offender violations with deterministic single-axis fixGuidance.

kernelVersion.description: CRAP scoring kernel version in effect when the report was produced.

escomplexVersion.description: Version of the package that computes the metrics (escomplex-plugin-metrics-module) used for the scan.

incomparable.description: Deprecated: always 0. The compare that refused methods with differing line-coordinate provenance was removed when CRAP rows stopped being keyed by startLine; kept for envelope compatibility.

provenanceMismatched.description: Deprecated: always 0. CRAP rows no longer carry a line coordinate, so there is no provenance to mismatch; kept for envelope compatibility.

unscorable.description: Story #4871: methods the scan could not score because no coverage artifact covered them. Reported rather than computed from an assumed zero percent coverage (which would drive CRAP maximal on untouched files).

scope.description: Story #1394: which scope produced this envelope. `diff` (default) = filter scan + baseline against the resolved git ref; `full` = full-repo scan via the `--full-scope` opt-out.

diffRef.description: Story #1394: the git ref the diff was scoped against (e.g. `main`, `epic/1386`), or null when `scope === 'full'`.

diagnostics.description: Story #4866: named, gate-level findings emitted INSTEAD of per-method verdicts when the gate has established that no verdict it could produce would be meaningful — an incomparable baseline or a baseline stamped ahead of the running code. Present only in that case; `violations` is then empty and the preview gate exits 0. `crap-unsound-comparison-basis` is a retired name kept in the enum for compatibility and no longer emitted.
